# Puskal Kafle

> Puskal Kafle is a UX Engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal, currently working at ITONICS. He specializes in designing and optimizing user interfaces for web applications — frontend performance, accessibility, and translating design concepts into functional, user-friendly products. He also builds and ships his own products: ProductImageUpscale AI (an AI image upscaler for e-commerce) and a set of production-grade components on the Framer Marketplace.

Primary site: https://puskalkafle.com.np/
Résumé: https://puskalkafle.com.np/resume (PDF: https://puskalkafle.com.np/assets/Puskal_Kafle_Resume.pdf)
Contact: puskal_kafle@yahoo.com

## Who he is

- Role: Senior Frontend Engineer · UI/UX (brands himself as a UX Engineer — UI/UX design + frontend development)
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Current employer: ITONICS (https://www.itonics-innovation.com/)
- Previous companies: Javra Software, EB Pearls
- Skills: UI/UX design, UX research, frontend development, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, RxJS, Storybook, CSS architecture, accessibility (WCAG), frontend performance, Figma, Framer, prototyping, D3/data visualization
- Education: Bachelor in Computer Engineering, Kathmandu University

## Work history (from résumé)

- Senior Frontend Engineer, ITONICS — Kathmandu, 04/2022–present. Designs and develops responsive UIs in Angular/TypeScript for an enterprise innovation-management platform, builds reusable documented components, unit testing, prototyping, Hotjar-driven UX analysis.
- Frontend Developer, ITONICS — 08/2016–04/2022. Designed UIs and specified frontend tasks for an enterprise AI-powered innovation-management platform used by companies like Adidas, Siemens and Toyota; improved frontend performance 20–30% and raised accessibility; enhanced theming architecture.
- Junior Frontend Developer, Javra Software — Lalitpur, 08/2015–08/2016. Hybrid mobile app (Ionic/PhoneGap), ES6 frontend features.
- Junior Web Designer, EB Pearls — Lalitpur, 05/2014–07/2015. Responsive client websites (HTML/CSS/JS, Bootstrap, jQuery), CMS integration.

## Products he built

- [ProductImageUpscale AI](https://www.productimageupscale.com/): AI photo enhancer and image upscaler for e-commerce. Upscales product images 2x, 4x or 8x while preserving texture, edges and colors; supports JPG/PNG/WebP and batch processing. Free plan and a Pro plan at $19/month.
- [ProductImageUpscale — Shopify app](https://apps.shopify.com/product-image-upscale-ai): one-click AI upscaling inside the Shopify admin.
- [Product Image Upscale — WordPress plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/product-image-upscale/): the same AI upscaling for WooCommerce/WordPress media.

## Case studies

- [Nepal Tourism Board Website Redesign](https://puskalkafle.com.np/work/ntb): 8-week UX project — traveler research (58% felt travel information was scattered), journey mapping, restructured information architecture and a redesigned, mobile-friendly UI for Nepal's official tourism platform.
- [Cryptocurrency App Concept](https://puskalkafle.com.np/work/crypto): dark-themed mobile app concept — market lists, portfolio risk scoring and trading screens, designed and prototyped in Figma.
- [ProductImageUpscale AI — Founder Case Study](https://puskalkafle.com.np/work/piu): how the AI upscaler was designed, built and shipped solo across web, Shopify and WordPress.
